decisions.reason: A multi-model line with its own website page signals visible commitment and fits the firm's core thermoforming offer for dental labs, so a slow start would likely be read as temporary.
The PETG blank is featured on its own page and is a low-cost addition to an established thermoforming range, so the firm has little reason to withdraw it after one year.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website, so public commitment is lower, but it is a cheap consumable that supports the digital workflow the firm has announced.
The intraoral contrast spray has its own page and supports intraoral scanning, which is central to the announced move into digital manufacturing, so management would persist.

Custom earmolds are core to the firm's custom-device manufacturing base and are offered as a product line with several models, so the investment would encourage persistence despite limited website prominence.
Custom hearing protection uses the same earmold production capabilities and serves growing markets, so early weak results would likely be attributed to market build-up time.
